Formulates and presents technology choices for the customer that will expand HPE's presence and margin in the account. Actively leverages HPE programs and tools (e.g. Executive Sponsors, BU deal support, and supply chain programs) to improve business performance. Significantly contributes to internal reviews connected to deals and sales planning. Actively engages with the customer to identify opportunities, starting from the higher levels of the customer organization. Identifies and develops high value opportunities for short, mid, and long term success. Proactively leads early engagements. Accountable for deal closure. Ensures end to end clear governance and ownership throughout the team, and across all deals in the pipeline. Drives deals of high complexity and size to closure through managing a multi-disciplinary team, including partners. Knowingly invests in maintaining and developing a professional relationship network within the customer to maximize efficiency and effectiveness for HPE. Understands and leverages the underlying principles for the customer organization's functioning. Builds influential relationships with executives including the C-level when necessary. Proactively defines an effective engagement model with the customer's key influencers and decision makers. Develops and maintains comprehensive view of the partner landscape in the account - from both IT and vertical industry perspectives. Proactively develops partner relationships. Runs an active governance process for the partner network for the account. Works with the Partner Business Manager to assess and update the partner strategy for the account. Constantly develops and updates expertise in IT technology. Engages effectively with the customer's CTO/CIO. Articulates relevant modern trends in IT and presents them to the C-level within the customer when appropriate. Describes portfolio pieces in detail and references their use in other customers. Mentors others within HPE. Actively builds, develops and leads the extended account team. Runs a comprehensive governance with the extended team and empowers the account team to engage on different levels within the account. Establishes a recurring process to provide feedback to the account team members and the relevant managers. Actively works with relevant managers to provide development opportunities for extended team members. Provides feedback into other HPE organizations and coordinates with other customer facing HPE organizations to improve the customer experience. Fully utilizes the entire set of HPE tools and processes for customer advocacy. Effectively leverages the existing tools, processes and resources to continuously assure a high level of customer satisfaction and loyalty. Fully owns the development and execution of a comprehensive account business plan for defined accounts. Leads the collective effort to build and maintain both strategic and tactical elements of the plan. Shares and aligns the plan with relevant stakeholders of the account. Education in engineering, technology, business, or a related field may be helpful but is not required. Fluency in both English and Dutch languages Experience with one or more relevant technology domains—such as hybrid cloud, AI, data, cybersecurity, networking, intelligent edge, or technology services—is helpful. Strategic Planning : Exceptional at articulating a vision for the future and a path to achieve it in an account business plan, aligned with the HPE strategy, direct leadership, and the HPE business units. Integrity : Acts with integrity throughout complex situations even if under pressure. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the compute that trains and serves our frontier models. Behind every cluster is a physical supply chain: servers, accelerators, networking equipment, spares, and tooling that have to be received, inspected, secured, tracked, and delivered to the right site at the right time. The Warehousing and Logistics team owns that flow, and this role runs its day-to-day operations in the US.

As Warehouse and Logistics Manager, you'll report to our Global Warehousing and Logistics Lead and own the operational management of all direct and third party logistics providers) of inbound receiving, storage, inventory control, kitting, and outbound shipments to our data center sites and partners. You'll manage the relationships and performance of our third-party warehouses, carriers, and freight forwarders, and you'll be the person on the ground when a shipment is late, a pallet arrives damaged, or a site needs a critical spare tomorrow morning.

This is a hands-on operational role on a small team, so you'll move between running the daily floor rhythm and building the processes, controls, and metrics that let us scale as our hardware footprint grows. You should be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, communicating clearly with engineers and vendors alike, and holding a high bar for accuracy and chain of custody on high-value, security-sensitive equipment.

Key responsibilities

•

Oversee the day-to-day warehouse operations across locations in North America, including receiving, inspection, put-away, storage, cycle counting, kitting, and outbound fulfillment to data center sites for the Anthropic owned warehouse and those run by Anthropic’s partners/ third party logistics providers

•

Own inventory accuracy and asset tracking for all infrastructure hardware, compute, MEP, spares, and consumables, maintaining clear chain of custody from dock to rack

•

Plan and execute domestic freight and coordinate international shipments, selecting carriers, managing schedules, and resolving exceptions such as delays, damage, and shortages

•

Manage third-party logistics providers, carriers, and freight forwarders, including onboarding, service-level tracking, performance reviews, and cost management

•

Coordinate closely with data center operations, hardware engineering, procurement, and security teams to align delivery schedules with deployment timelines and site readiness

•

Operate reverse logistics for returns, RMAs, and end-of-life equipment, including secure handling and disposition of storage devices in partnership with security and compliance

•

Build and document standard operating procedures, checklists, and controls for warehouse and shipping activities, and train warehouse staff and vendors on them

•

Maintain compliance with safety, hazardous materials, export control, and customs requirements for the equipment we handle

•

Define and report on operational metrics such as receiving cycle time, inventory accuracy, on-time delivery, and freight cost, and use them to drive continuous improvement

•

Support capacity planning for warehouse space, staffing, and equipment as our hardware volumes and site count grow

Minimum qualifications

•

Experience managing warehouse or logistics operations for physical goods, including receiving, inventory control, and outbound shipping

•

Hands-on experience with a warehouse management or inventory management system, and comfort working in spreadsheets to analyze inventory and shipment data

•

Experience managing third-party logistics providers or carriers, including negotiating service levels and holding vendors accountable to them

•

Working knowledge of domestic freight (LTL, FTL, and parcel) and the documentation that goes with it

•

Familiarity with safety and regulatory requirements for shipping and storing IT or electronic equipment, such as hazardous materials rules for lithium batteries

•

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across technical and non-technical teams and external partners

•

Demonstrated ability to build processes from scratch and keep operations running reliably as volume and complexity increase

•

Ability to travel to warehouse and data center sites in the US as needed

Preferred qualifications

•

Experience handling data center or enterprise IT hardware, including servers, GPUs or other accelerators, and networking equipment

•

Experience with international freight forwarding, customs brokerage, and export control requirements such as EAR

•

Experience with secure chain-of-custody programs, asset tagging, and data-bearing device sanitization or destruction

•

Experience directly managing warehouse staff or contract labor

•

Familiarity with ERP or procurement systems and how inventory data flows between them and warehouse systems

•

Experience with lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methods

•

Forklift certification or experience overseeing material handling equipment operations

•

Experience supporting rapid infrastructure buildouts, whether in cloud, telecom, or another hardware-intensive industry

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Position Summary

• The Human Resources Generalist serves as the “face of HR” for employees and management, providing consistent, high-quality support across employee relations, labor relations, recruiting, onboarding, compensation, benefits, compliance, engagement, and employee development. This role acts as an employee advocate, HR advisor, and culture builder while supporting the delivery of standard HR processes and talent activities for individual employees and managers.
• Reporting to the HR Manager and partnering closely with HR Business Partners, HR Programs, and specialist teams, the HR Generalist supports site-level HR execution and helps ensure HR policies, programs, and practices are delivered accurately, consistently, and in alignment with company values. Experienced or high-potential HR Generalists may own a client group and continue developing toward the HR Manager role.

Core Accountabilities

Site HR Ownership (Day-to-Day Execution)

• Serve as the primary HR point of contact and trusted advisor for employees and managers regarding HR policies, employment-related questions, employee relations, and people-related matters.
• Manage day-to-day HR activities, including routine and, at times, more complex employee relations matters, investigations, corrective action, discipline, performance management support, and follow-up, escalating high-risk matters as appropriate.
• Complete employee lifecycle activities by location, including onboarding, offboarding, job changes, compensation changes, hiring support, terminations, investigations, employment status updates, and related documentation.
• Prepare, obtain required approvals for, and maintain accurate employee records in the HRIS, including department transfers, salary changes, new hires, terminations, and related reporting in partnership with HRIS and payroll teams.
• Support time and attendance matters, leave administration, disability coordination, benefits-related questions, and the interactive process in partnership with benefits administrators and specialist teams.
• Facilitate and advise on recurring HR programs, including goal setting, performance reviews, talent planning, salary planning, employee development, engagement action planning, and other programmatic HR activities.
• Execute site and functional HR priorities, initiatives, compliance requirements, and training obligations for assigned client groups or locations.

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Support

• Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Managers, and hiring managers to identify staffing needs, develop or update job descriptions, initiate postings, support interview processes, and help fill roles efficiently and consistently.
• Support recruiting execution, including job postings, interview coordination, background checks, candidate communications, and participation on interview panels as appropriate.
• Ensure a positive, compliant, and effective onboarding experience by working directly with new hires and coaching hiring managers on onboarding expectations.

Employee Experience, Engagement & Culture

• Serve as a visible HR presence and culture builder, developing trusted relationships with employees and leaders at all levels.
• Champion employee engagement, recognition, talent development, survey participation, action planning, and follow-up execution.
• Support local delivery of HR programs and initiatives led by HR Business Partners and HR Programs, including performance management cycles, change initiatives, engagement programs, and compensation-related processes.

Partnership & Collaboration

• Build and maintain strong relationships across the HR team, internal partner groups, client group leaders, and employees across field and home office locations.
• Conduct regular 1:1 meetings with key client group leaders at the Director and/or VP level, as appropriate, to understand business needs and provide HR guidance.
• Partner with HR Managers and HR Business Partners by providing site insights, data, and on-the-ground feedback to inform talent reviews, workforce planning, compensation processes, and business-unit initiatives.
• Run and analyze standard and ad hoc HRIS reports to support HR leadership, decision-making, and data integrity.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/aa33a9ec-53f6-4bf9-88b7-490af6a12624/custom%20programming%20group%20no%20code.jpeg]

WE'RE LOOKING FOR A MARTECH ENGINEER TO OWN AND EVOLVE OUR CRM DATA PLATFORM. TODAY IT POWERS SCHEDULED DATA SYNCS; TOMORROW IT WILL POWER REAL-TIME, MULTI-CHANNEL MARKETING AND AUDIENCE ACTIVATION ACROSS EMAIL, MOBILE PUSH NOTIFICATIONS, AND FUTURE CHANNELS LIKE WHATSAPP.

This is a platform engineering role with product ownership. You'll build the systems behind CRM while owning the platform end to end-from architecture and reliability to governance and self-service. You'll also partner with the engineers responsible for our mobile attribution platform to support our marketing measurement stack.

The Marketing Data team builds the automation and infrastructure behind Supercell's player lifecycle marketing and marketing measurement. We move player data and events between our data warehouse, CRM platform, and attribution stack-reliably, securely, and at scale.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7a053edc-bf2e-4db4-85ee-5630e2b5d305/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the CRM data platform. Build and operate reliable, scalable, and compliant data pipelines between our warehouse and CRM platforms, and build strong engineering partnerships with internal teams and vendors.

- Build real-time capabilities. Deliver player events into and from the CRM platform in near real time to power triggered lifecycle messaging and richer player experiences.

- Expand our messaging channels. Build the data, identity, and subscription foundations that enable channels such as email, mobile push notifications, and future messaging platforms to launch on the same reliable infrastructure.

- Support marketing measurement. Partner on our mobile attribution stack, helping ensure accurate attribution and conversion data flows between marketing platforms and our warehouse - so marketing performance can be measured end to end.

- Build privacy by design. Ensure consent, identity management and GDPR requirements are built into the platform from day one, alongside platform- and region- specific mobile privacy frameworks and requirements.

- Enable self-service. Build tools and workflows that allow new CRM data sources and events to be onboarded quickly, safely, and with minimal engineering effort.

- Build reliable production systems. Apply good engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, observability, alerting, and resilient system design.

WHAT IT MIGHT LOOK LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

- Move CRM from batch to real time. Build a Kinesis-to-Braze event service for a high-value player trigger, validate its latency and reliability, then scale it into a reusable platform capability.

- Launch mobile push notifications as a first-class channel. Build the data, identity, and subscription foundations, launch the channel for one game, then create a repeatable onboarding model for future games.

- Connect CRM to our internal CDP. Integrate with our internal audience platform so internally built audiences are available as a CRM platform activation layer.

- Evolve the CRM workspace architecture. As the CRM program grows, lead the evolution from a shared workspace to a workspace-per-game model while keeping identity, reporting, and data pipelines consistent.

- Reduce onboarding from days to minutes. Build a documented, validated self-service onboarding workflow so new CRM data syncs can be added quickly and safely with minimal engineering effort.

- Turn CRM audiences into paid retargeting. Use the CRM platform's and custom in-house ad-platform connectors to activate player audiences for retargeting, closing the loop between owned and paid channels.

- Strengthen privacy and compliance. Validate consent and age restrictions, and account deletion across both batch and real-time pipelines, backed by automated testing and monitoring.

TO EXCEL HERE, YOU

- Own systems, not just code. This is a platform engineering role with product ownership. You can take a problem from an idea to a reliable, production service.

- Are a strong engineer. You're comfortable building production services and integrating with APIs at scale.

- Have strong data engineering skills. You have experience with PySpark, Delta Lake, Databricks (or a similar platform), and building reliable batch and streaming pipelines.

- Are comfortable with AWS and modern platform engineering. You have experience with services such as Kinesis, S3, and IAM, infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), and modern CI/CD practices.

- Have built event-driven systems. You understand streaming technologies such as Kinesis, Kafka, or Pub/Sub, including ordering, retries, backpressure, and failure handling.

- Know CRM and engagement platforms. Braze experience is ideal, but experience with similar platforms is equally valuable.

- Understand messaging platforms. You're familiar with email and mobile push notifications, along with the identity and subscription models behind them.

- Build with privacy in mind. You understand consent management, GDPR, data retention, and handle data responsibly.

- Communicate well across disciplines. You enjoy working with engineers, marketers, and analysts, and know when to build self-service solutions versus owning operational complexity.

- Thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable owning problems, learning quickly, and focusing on impact for players.

WOULD BE NICE IF YOU ALSO HAVE

- Experience evolving a CRM or lifecycle platform from batch to real time.

- Hands-on experience with Braze (Currents, CDI, REST APIs, subscription groups, Liquid personalization).

- Experience with email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sending domains, and domain/IP warm-up.

- Experience operating mobile push notification platforms (APNs/FCM).

- Experience with digital advertising networks ETL and rETL connectors

- Experience in mobile gaming or other high-scale b2c products.

- Experience using AI or LLM tools in your engineering workflow.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll join the Marketing Data team within Marketing Data & Analytics. We build the infrastructure behind marketing automation, attribution, that provides measurement across Supercell.

Your work will support all of our games-including Brawl Stars, Clash of Clans, Clash Royale, Hay Day and other titles - and the performance marketing teams behind them.

The role can be based in Helsinki or London, with regular time spent at our Helsinki headquarters.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/88b3477a-7124-479e-babc-94125c5b23be/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]

ABOUT SUPERCELL

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings https://supercell.com/en/news/learning-from-failures/, and killing lots of projects.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/0272a5b3-a7a2-4f1c-b97b-725eae66daf0/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]

HEY, YOU MIGHT LOVE IT HERE!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/49ae2117-cfbb-4fbd-bc4c-f67357d2f376/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]

YOU ARE NOT YOUR JOB TITLE ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/860d5de4-aa96-4e01-879c-889b7039330b/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/b52ac2fb-3f94-46bc-9c36-32ad780b2eae/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]

RELOCATION? YES!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/58a0cf4e-e26b-461b-8541-2129dc6b7311/banner_narrow_portraits-2025-ashby.jpg]

NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

The PPE (Payments, Protection & Experience) Fraud team plays a critical role in protecting Coupang customers, sellers, and the business from fraudulent activities while maintaining a seamless customer experience. By leveraging data, analytics, and scalable data solutions, the team identifies fraud patterns, measures risk, and enables data-driven decision-making across Fraud Operations, Product, Engineering, and Risk stakeholders.
This role combines strong business analytics capabilities with data engineering expertise. The position focuses on designing scalable data solutions, building and maintaining robust data pipelines, and delivering actionable insights that drive fraud prevention strategies and operational excellence. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable translating fraud-related business requirements into data solutions and developing reliable, efficient backend data systems that support risk management and fraud detection.

Business Partnership & Solution Design
Collaborate closely with Fraud Operations, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, dashboards, and analytical solutions.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and datasets supporting fraud analytics, investigations, and risk decisioning.
Develop new data ingestion pipelines, including integrations with internal and external data sources using Python.
Ensure reliability of fraud data systems by monitoring pipelines, troubleshooting failures, and maintaining business-critical datasets.
Data Quality & Governance
Implement robust data quality monitoring and validation frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency of fraud-related reporting.
Maintain and enhance core fraud and risk datasets to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Manage data lineage documentation and establish clear visibility into data sources, transformations, and downstream usage.
Performance Optimization
Optimize data processing workflows and warehouse performance through advanced SQL tuning and query optimization.
Continuously improve existing datasets, data infrastructure, and reporting tools to increase scalability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual processes and improve operational productivity.
Scalable Analytics Enablement
Build self-service dashboards and scalable reporting solutions that empower stakeholders to monitor fraud performance and key risk indicators.
Enable faster and more effective decision-making through automated reporting and analytical frameworks.
Support experimentation and measurement initiatives to evaluate fraud controls, policy changes, and product enhancements.
Continuous Improvement
Stay current with industry best practices, fraud detection methodologies, and emerging data technologies.
Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen fraud analytics capabilities, data infrastructure, and risk management processes.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Fraud Analytics, Risk Analytics, Data Engineering, or related quantitative fields.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex fraud and business challenges into actionable insights.
Advanced SQL skills
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, dashboards, and scalable reporting solutions.

AI Transformation Dept.은 크래프톤 전사의 AI 전환(AX)을 주도하는 조직입니다.

현업 조직이 AI를 활용하여 업무 생산성을 혁신할 수 있도록 전략 수립, 기술 지원, 교육 및 직접 실행을 담당하며, 특히 AXI(AX Impact) 프로젝트를 통해 현업 밀착형 AI 업무 자동화를 추진하고 있습니다. AI DevOps Engineer는 AX 결과물이 안전하고 빠르게 개발·배포·테스트·운영될 수 있는 환경을 구축·운영하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 본 포지션은 인프라 운영을 직접 수행하기보다, AI/ML 기반 예측·자동화 체계를 설계하고 SRE 방법론을 전사에 확산·주도하는 역할입니다.
